analysis: Weight-movement audit on V1 of the 18 main cells under deterministic APS.

protocol.uncertainty_and_matching: Cached VNE records and heuristic match labels; no reclustering or rematching
protocol.tie_rule: Exact equality of integer sums of V1 set sizes; first minimum on ascending grid
protocol.interpretation: A unique grid minimum is not statistical or mechanistic identifiability; movement is necessary but insufficient for uniqueness.
